name: Salesforce
desc: CRM platform for sales, service, and marketing.
gate_detail: Free Developer Edition + trials, no approval needed.
api: REST, SOAP, Bulk, Metadata, GraphQL (pilot) — very broad, mature.
mcp: Yes (Agentforce/MCP tooling); already a Composio toolkit.

name: HubSpot
desc: All-in-one marketing, sales, and service CRM.
gate_detail: Free tier + free developer test accounts.

name: Pipedrive
desc: Sales pipeline CRM for small/mid sales teams.
gate_detail: Free trial, no perpetual free tier.
mcp: Third-party MCP servers exist; confirmed Composio toolkit.

name: Attio
gate_detail: Free plan + trial.

name: Twenty
gate_detail: Free self-host (MIT-style license) or free cloud tier.
api: REST + auto-generated GraphQL, full CRUD incl. custom objects.
mcp: Unofficial community MCP servers exist; no official one yet.

name: Podio
desc: Flexible work-management/CRM hybrid, now under Progress Software.
gate_detail: Basic tier still free; self-serve developer account.
api: REST — apps, items, tasks, workspaces, webhooks. Functional but legacy.
blocker: Platform ownership changed hands (Citrix→Progress, 2024); low ecosystem momentum.

name: Zoho CRM
desc: CRM module of the Zoho suite.
gate_detail: Free tier (≤3 users) + trial.

name: Close
desc: Sales CRM with built-in calling for SMB teams.
gate_detail: 14-day trial, no perpetual free tier.

name: Copper
desc: CRM built to live inside Google Workspace.
gate_detail: Free trial; API key self-serve from account settings.
api: REST, full CRM object graph; modest rate limits (180–600 req/min).

name: DealCloud
desc: Deal/relationship intelligence CRM for PE, IB, professional services (Intapp).
gate_detail: Requires an existing paid DealCloud client site; sales-led onboarding.
api: REST, well-documented per-tenant Swagger (auth, user mgmt, schema, data).
blocker: No trial/sandbox without an existing enterprise contract.

name: Zendesk
gate_detail: Free trial, no perpetual free tier.
api: REST, very broad (tickets, users, help center, talk).
mcp: Likely official server; not independently re-verified.

name: Intercom
gate_detail: Free trial, no perpetual free tier.
mcp: Believed to have an official server; not independently re-verified.

name: Freshdesk
gate_detail: Free tier + trial.
mcp: Trending on Composio's own toolkit directory (seen live).

name: Front
gate_detail: Trial only; API access generally needs a paid plan.

name: Pylon
gate_detail: Token generated in-dashboard, but you must already be a Pylon customer.
api: REST at api.usepylon.com — teams, issues, accounts, contacts.
mcp: Yes — official hosted server at mcp.usepylon.com (docs list 11 tools; live surface reportedly larger, ~29).

name: LiveAgent
gate_detail: 14-day free trial; key generated from account.

name: Plain
desc: Modern B2B customer support tool built for software companies.
gate_detail: Free tier, self-serve signup.

name: Help Scout
desc: Email-based helpdesk for small support teams.
gate_detail: Free trial; paid plan generally needed for API.

name: Gorgias
gate_detail: Free trial.

name: Gladly
desc: Enterprise CX platform for large retail/consumer brands.
gate_detail: No public self-serve signup; sold via demo to larger orgs.
api: REST, reportedly well documented but access requires being a customer.
blocker: Sales-gated account, no trial found.

name: Slack
gate_detail: Free tier, fully self-serve.
api: REST + Events API + Socket Mode — extremely broad.
mcp: Yes, official remote MCP; confirmed Composio toolkit.

name: Twilio
desc: Programmable SMS, voice, video, and communications APIs.
gate_detail: Free trial credit, fully self-serve signup.
mcp: Not found; Composio has separate WhatsApp/Twilio-adjacent toolkits.

name: Zoho Cliq
desc: Team chat app, part of the Zoho suite.
gate_detail: Free tier.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
desc: ByteDance's all-in-one collaboration suite (chat, docs, calendar).
gate_detail: Free tier for smaller teams; open developer platform.
api: REST, very broad Open Platform (messaging, docs, calendar, approvals).

name: Pumble
gate_detail: No broad public developer API surface found.
api: Not found — appears limited to basic webhooks at best.
blocker: No public API/dev docs located — flagged for hand verification.

name: Discord
desc: Community/voice chat platform with a mature bot ecosystem.
gate_detail: Fully free, open developer portal.
mcp: Community MCP servers common; no single official one confirmed.

name: Telegram
desc: Messaging app with an accessible Bot API.
gate_detail: Instant bot token issuance, fully open.
api: Bot API (REST-like) very accessible; full MTProto client API more complex.

name: WhatsApp Business
gate_detail: Self-serve to start, but requires Meta Business verification, WABA setup, template approval.
api: Cloud API (REST), broad but strict policy rules.
blocker: Verification/compliance friction before production use.

name: Aircall
desc: Cloud call center / business phone system.
gate_detail: Trial + paid plans; API access self-serve from account.

name: Vonage
desc: Communications APIs (SMS, Voice, Verify, Video) — formerly Nexmo.
gate_detail: Fully self-serve signup with free trial credit.

name: Google Ads
gate_detail: Self-serve signup, but production-level developer token requires Google approval (Basic→Standard access review).
blocker: Developer token approval can take days to weeks.

name: Meta Ads
gate_detail: Dev access self-serve; production ads_management permission needs Meta App Review.
blocker: App Review gate for advanced permissions.

name: LinkedIn Ads
gate_detail: Marketing API requires LinkedIn Partner Program approval — selective, can take weeks.
blocker: Partner Program approval is the main blocker, not the API itself.

name: GoHighLevel
gate_detail: Developer/marketplace account self-serve; sub-account access requires a GHL account.

name: Mailchimp
desc: Email marketing and marketing automation platform.
gate_detail: Free tier.

name: Klaviyo
gate_detail: Free tier for low contact volume.

name: systeme.io
gate_detail: Free plan; key self-serve from account settings.

name: Pinterest
gate_detail: Dev app self-serve; some scopes (ads, business features) need app trust review.
blocker: Standard-access review for higher-trust scopes.

name: Threads (Meta)
gate_detail: Developer app self-serve via Meta for Developers.
api: REST (Threads API) — narrower than Graph API, still maturing.

name: SendGrid
gate_detail: Free tier (limited sends/day).

name: Shopify
gate_detail: Free dev store + Partner account, fully self-serve.
api: REST + GraphQL (GraphQL now primary), extremely broad.
mcp: Strong agent/MCP ecosystem interest; official + third-party servers.

name: WooCommerce
gate_detail: Free, open source, self-hosted.

name: BigCommerce
gate_detail: Free trial store, self-serve API account creation.

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
gate_detail: No public trial; requires a provisioned enterprise instance.

name: Squarespace
gate_detail: Dev account self-serve; Commerce endpoints historically required a Commerce-tier plan.

name: Ecwid
gate_detail: Free plan; self-serve OAuth app registration.

name: Gumroad
gate_detail: Free to start selling; self-serve API app registration.

name: fanbasis

blocker: Guided onboarding rather than instant self-serve signup.

name: DataForSEO
gate_detail: Fully self-serve, pay-as-you-go, no sales contact.
api: REST, extremely broad (SERP, keywords, backlinks, on-page, business data).

name: SE Ranking
gate_detail: Requires an active paid subscription; self-serve upgrade.

name: Ahrefs
gate_detail: API access requires a paid plan + API credits; no free tier.

name: MrScraper
gate_detail: Self-serve signup with trial credits (typical of this category).

name: Apify

gate_detail: Free tier with monthly credits.

name: Firecrawl
desc: Web scraping/crawling API built for LLM pipelines.
gate_detail: Free tier, self-serve signup.

gate_detail: No account, no key; runs locally.

name: Waterfall.io
gate_detail: Key issued instantly on signup; usage-based pricing, no contracts.
api: REST — Prospector, Contact/Phone/Company Enrichment, Email Verification.

blocker: "API" means different things at different tiers — worth clarifying with the customer.

name: GitHub
gate_detail: Fully free/open.
api: REST + GraphQL, extremely broad and mature.
mcp: Yes, official GitHub MCP server; confirmed Composio toolkit.

name: Vercel
gate_detail: Free Hobby tier.

name: Netlify
gate_detail: Free tier.

desc: CDN, DNS, security, and edge-compute platform.

name: Supabase
gate_detail: Generous free tier.

gate_detail: 30-day free trial with credits, self-serve signup.

name: Datadog

gate_detail: Free Developer tier.

name: Brex

name: PitchBook

api: REST (sessions, playbooks, knowledge, secrets) + OpenAPI specs.

name: higgsfield

gate_detail: Free npm package, no account, no key.
api: N/A — not a hosted service; an agent shells out to it locally.
